content.value: An INK-like Go terminal renderer that draws PortableDoc blocks inside the Go TUI's paper viewer.

that renders PortableDoc block trees as styled terminal output — think INK, but in Go and aimed at the terminal. It is not a standalone client; it is a rendering engine embedded inside the Go TUI, so it sits within the Surfaces family of Barkpark as the piece that turns structured documents into readable terminal frames.
The Go TUI's paper viewer hands

a PortableDoc — Barkpark's portable block format — and gets back laid-out, styled output. That includes Bulldocs papers: a Bulldocs document is a tree of PortableDoc blocks (headings, paragraphs, callouts, code), and
is what makes one legible in a terminal instead of dumping raw JSON. The document itself arrives over HTTP API v1 — served by the Phoenix API — like any other Document.
